surface.description: Read-only monitoring map for the GPT-Realtime-2 model page.

prompt.mission: Read the declared model pricing state, preserve a dated observation, and compare only the named fields against the prior observation.
prompt.boundaries: This map is read-only. It contains no action that changes the page, account, model configuration, billing, or any other remote state.

notes.refresh_cadence: Run weekly and before publishing pricing-sensitive offers or estimates.
notes.failure_policy: If card_count is not 8, complete is false, a price is absent, or the route does not match, record a failed observation and do not infer or carry forward a price.
notes.mutation_policy: No mutations are permitted by this map. Any future mutation must be a separate reviewed action with an exact payload preview, explicit approval, and independent postcondition read.

tools.name: openai.model.pricing.map
tools.description: Return the monitoring contract and the required dated-observation workflow. Call this before reading the pricing projection.

static_output.comparison_rule: Compare only the declared JSON Pointer fields. Missing or incomplete current state is a failed observation, not evidence of a price change.

state_projections.name: openai.model.pricing
state_projections.description: Current GPT-Realtime-2 text, audio, and image token prices as eight labeled cards. Returns complete=false unless all eight cards are present.

projection.expression: {% {'source_url': 'https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-realtime-2', 'model': 'gpt-realtime-2', 'unit': 'USD per 1M tokens', 'card_count': $count(records.price_cards), 'complete': $count(records.price_cards) = 8, 'cards': $append([], records.price_cards), 'prices': {'text': {'input': records.price_cards[0].price, 'cached_input': records.price_cards[1].price, 'output': records.price_cards[2].price}, 'audio': {'input': records.price_cards[3].price, 'cached_input': records.price_cards[4].price, 'output': records.price_cards[5].price}, 'image': {'input': records.price_cards[6].price, 'cached_input': records.price_cards[7].price}}} %}
